readings.title: The fifteen-minute notebook
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: After returning to college, Lena tried to study for three hours every Sunday. Family visits often interrupted the plan. She began carrying a small notebook and used fifteen minutes before her evening bus to recall one idea without looking at the textbook. At home she checked what she had remembered and marked uncertain points. Her weekly study time did not increase greatly, but she arrived at tutorials with more specific questions. She still needed longer sessions for essays. The notebook helped her maintain contact with the course between those sessions.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: A timetable with a margin
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: An evening college used to schedule presentations immediately after the final lesson of each unit. Several employed students said a single late shift could leave them unprepared. The college moved presentations three days later without changing the submission standard. Tutors provided a checklist at the last lesson, while a short online question period remained optional. More students presented on time that term. However, the college recorded changes in enrolment too, so it did not claim that the timetable alone explained the improvement. It planned to collect comments before repeating the arrangement.
knowledgePoints: 阅读理解：主旨、细节、推断与词义

readings.title: Explaining the missed step
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: At a weekend mathematics class, Ravi often reached the correct answer but could not explain his method. His tutor asked pairs to solve one problem separately and then compare each step. Ravi discovered that he had been applying a rule he remembered without checking its conditions. His partner made a different mistake and could explain why it happened. Neither was appointed the permanent teacher. By exchanging roles, both practised asking precise questions. The activity took longer than checking an answer sheet, but it showed the tutor what each learner understood.

readings.title: The notice nobody opened
readings.instruction: Read the original passage and choose the best answer to each question.
readings.content: A course administrator sent all updates in a weekly attachment called Information. Learners frequently missed room changes buried on its third page. She began placing urgent changes in the email itself, with the date and room number in the subject line. The attachment remained available for longer explanations. She also printed essential notices at reception for students who seldom checked email. Fewer people went to the wrong room. The administrator concluded that making information available was only the first step; its location and wording affected whether people could use it.

translation.stem:
Translate this original passage into natural Chinese, preserving its meaning and logical connections.

Returning to education often means making room for study within an already busy life. A realistic plan should include time for rest as well as assignments. When unexpected duties interrupt that plan, learners can adjust the next step without treating the whole week as a failure. Small decisions repeated patiently may build a lasting habit.
translation.referenceAnswer: 重返校园往往意味着在本已忙碌的生活中为学习留出时间。切实可行的计划既应安排作业，也应安排休息。当意外的责任打乱计划时，学习者可以调整下一步，而不必把整周都看作失败。耐心地反复作出小小的决定，可能会养成持久的习惯。
translation.explanation: 参考译文不是唯一答案；信息完整、逻辑准确且中文自然的其他译法同样有效。

writing.stem:
Write about 120 words in English for this original simulation task.

Write an email to an evening-course adviser requesting a change of study group because your work hours have changed. Explain the conflict, propose an alternative, and ask how completed assignments will be handled.
writing.sampleAnswer: Dear Course Adviser, I am taking the Monday accounting course, but my employer has recently moved my weekly stock check to Monday evening. I can still study regularly, although attending that group will now be difficult. Could I transfer to the Wednesday class next month? Wednesday is my fixed day off, so this arrangement would allow me to participate fully. I have already submitted two assignments and would appreciate confirmation that their marks can transfer. Please also let me know whether I need to complete a form or speak with the new tutor. I will continue attending my present group whenever possible while the request is considered. Thank you for helping me find a workable solution. Yours sincerely, Alex.
writing.explanation: 范文展示一种可行的回应；允许不同观点和例子，按任务完成、组织和语言评分。

criteria.name: 任务完成与内容
criteria.description: 回应题目全部要求，观点明确，理由、例子或建议与情境相关。

criteria.name: 组织与衔接
criteria.description: 段落信息顺序合理，衔接自然，格式适合写作目的。

criteria.name: 语言与表达
criteria.description: 用词恰当，语法准确；按错误对理解的影响扣分。

knowledgePoints: 英语写作：任务回应与连贯表达
